name: @sos-2/telemetry-runtime
description: SOS 2.0 Telemetry Runtime (Work Order P7): the poll-driven host side of runtime telemetry ingestion. Pulls W3 TelemetrySource ports on the observation loop's ticks and converts every RawObservation capture into a replay-protected observation event through the P7 event-ingestion pipeline — carrying the capture VERBATIM so capture-level availability truth states (SUCCESS/FAILURE/UNKNOWN/UNAVAILABLE/UNSUPPORTED/PARTIAL) survive bit-exact (gaps stay gaps; unavailable is never folded into zero or success). Pull failures are typed outcomes with honest failure reasons; the runtime fabricates nothing. Provider health signals surface as events for the provider-health projection. No ambient timers/network/process: the tick source, telemetry sources, clock and pipeline are all injected; real telemetry backends attach later as TelemetrySource adapters.
